title: Evidence for one check run (agent → Athena), also the format of lab/reference/*.evidence.json
description: Grading input (src/lib/labs/language/evidence.ts). Items missing from a role grade as `not collected`.

params.description: Reference evidence only: the parameter values the reference machine was built with.

roles.description: Lab role → what that machine reported.

item.description: One gathered item: { ok: true, …fields of its primitive } or { ok: false, error, message }.

oneOf.description: file: exists, path, size, mode, owner, group, mtime, sha256, content | content_b64, truncated. glob: files[] of file results. run: exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms, timed_out, truncated. service: load_state, active_state, sub_state, unit_file_state. package: installed {name: version}. log: content (appended since the baseline), rotated, truncated.
